preconditions: Owned project fixtures; installed development dependencies; isolated process state.
steps: Read or validate the declared project resources and observe data, rejection and file effects.

oracle.requirement_contract: SpecRoad MUSS eine nicht unterstützte `schema_version` ablehnen und die höchste unterstützte Version in der Diagnose nennen.
oracle.scope: Strict UTF-8 JSON resource reads, closed trusted descriptors, owned data and all-or-nothing explicit sets; exact decimal roundtrip rejection.

open_items: Complete per-artifact and persisted-resource schemas are implemented by later steps.
JCS serialization/hash implementation, full model inventory and transaction publication are not part of this reader.
